name: Image administration
description: Requests a picture from the image administration program for every empty picture slot (page type pictures, pictures in page text, detail maps, tokens, handouts, scene backgrounds), and receives the pictures people upload there. Talks HTTP only; it never needs access to the other program's files.

config.label: Image administration address
config.help: Where the image administration server runs, for example http://admin-host:4870.

config.label: Admin token
config.help: Sent as a Bearer token on every call to image administration. Never make that server public.

config.label: Webhook token
config.help: Image administration must be started with --webhook <this Chronicle address>/api/plugins/image-administration/webhook --webhook-token <this value>. Without it pushed images are refused and pictures arrive by catch-up only.

config.label: Request page type pictures
config.help: Every empty image block of a page's special page type: the portrait or banner, and the further pictures of custom types.

config.label: Request pictures inside page text
config.help: A paragraph that is only [image: what it shows] asks for a picture; it is replaced by the picture when it arrives.

config.label: Request detail maps
config.help: A map pin that points at a page but opens no map gets a tiled detail map, as a child of the map with the pin.

config.label: Request token pictures
config.help: One request per token name; the picture goes to every token of that name that has none.

config.label: Request scene backgrounds
config.help: At the scene's own size, so the background fits exactly.

config.label: Only these page types (pictures)
config.help: Ids of special page types, separated by commas (built in: person, monster, item, location). Empty: every type.

config.label: Only these page types (detail maps)
config.help: Pins that point at pages of these types get a map request. Empty: every type.

config.label: Wide picture width in pixels
config.help: For wide image blocks such as a location banner; the height follows the block's 16:7 shape.

config.label: Square picture width in pixels
config.help: The exact frame. The upload screen scales and crops a picture of another size to it.

config.label: Delivery folder
config.help: Folder inside the image administration project for the delivered files.

config.label: Check every (minutes)
config.help: How often to ask for new requests and fetch pictures that a push missed. 0 turns the timer off.

actions.label: Request images now
actions.help: Looks at every page again and requests an image for each one that needs it and was not requested yet.

actions.label: Fetch new images
actions.help: Fetches pictures that were uploaded in image administration since the last one handled.
